cards.issue: Published observational comparison (harvest not randomised) on resin (stem tapping) harvest
cards.why_it_matters: Mean long-term growth rate λ 0.962 in harvested populations vs 0.954 in the comparison populations (difference +0.008; 1 vs 1 matrices).
cards.uncertainty: Site-specific: results come from Metema & Adi Arkay, Ethiopia. Tapped vs untapped populations; the paper's conclusion is that both decline because of blocked regeneration (grazing, fire), independent of tapping.
cards.recommended_next: Use it as a scenario in the Studio; local stage counts and recovery measurements are still needed before setting any limit.
